subject: Joint Onramp Canvas + starter template (draft)
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@acmehealth.com>, Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 May 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Joint Onramp Canvas + starter template (draft)

Hi Sarah / Carlos —

Thanks again for a great conversation this morning. Per our follow-up, attached is a lightly seeded "Joint Onramp Canvas" that pairs a 30-day evaluation checklist with milestone owners and acceptance criteria. The goal is to give your team a tight, unblockable path to validate Redwood in a single sprint while preserving your security/QA gates.

What's in this draft:
- A one-page timeline (week-by-week) with owner assignments
- Acceptance criteria per milestone (connectivity, sample throughput, latency target)
- Core evaluation KPIs (throughput, median p95 latency, token cost per inference)
- A short executive checklist for procurement and legal (PO timeline, security contacts)

Quick asks from you:
1) Who will be the technical owner on your side for infra and testing?
2) Any required success KPIs we should add or replace?
3) Preferred date for a 30-minute kickoff next week (we can run the MAP review + environment checklist).

Attachments: Joint-Onramp-Canvas-v0.1.gdoc (seed), MAP-Checklist-30d-MVP.gslides, Acme-Eval-KPIs.xlsx

If it helps, I can convert the Canvas into a shared slide we can co-edit live on the kickoff.

Thanks — looking forward to locking a kickoff slot.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee | Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@acmehealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 7 May 2028 09:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Joint Onramp Canvas + starter template (draft)

Thanks, Soojin — this looks useful. A couple quick notes from our side after reviewing the seed doc: 

- Technical owner: I'll loop in our Platform lead, Carlos Ruiz, but Carlos will only be hands-on for infra prep. The day-to-day test lead will be Lina Park (cc'd on my calendar invite).
- KPIs: we care most about median latency at our 512-token baseline, and end-to-end throughput per node. Could you add a small row for "QA pass rate on representative prompts"? That will be part of our acceptance gate.
- Procurement: we have an internal 14-day PO window once pricing is agreed; legal will need SOC 2 scope confirmation.

For kickoff, Tue 5/9 10am ET or Wed 5/10 11am ET both work for the team. Prefer Tue if possible.

Also attaching the initial list of sample prompts and a short doc with compliance questions (we'll send the full security packet through the portal).

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Chen | Director of Platform Engineering
Acme Health

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@acmehealth.com>, Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 May 2028 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Joint Onramp Canvas + starter template (draft)

Appreciate the quick feedback, Sarah — great to know Lina will own day-to-day. I've updated the seed doc with the QA pass-rate KPI and a 512-token median-latency row. Both are in the attached Acme-Eval-KPIs.xlsx (tab: Acceptance Criteria).

Proposed kickoff: Tue 2028-05-09 10:00 ET — I'll send a calendar invite with a short 20-minute agenda:
- 5m intro + roles
- 8m review MAP timeline + acceptance criteria
- 7m environment checklist + test data prep

Prep items for the kickoff (we'll keep the list light so it's actionable):
- Acme: identify a test user with a short prompt set (5-10 prompts) and a small sample dataset (1-2 GB) available via S3 or a shared bucket
- Redwood: standing service account + temporary API key for the trial; base config and a quick runbook for test harness setup

Marissa / Ben — can one of you confirm service-account provisioning cadence and whether we can have a temporary key set up same day as the kickoff? Also, pricing note: Sarah mentioned a 14-day PO window; if we need a PO for the pilot, Marissa, could you please outline the typical pilot billing flow and any options for a trial credit?

Attaching updated links in case people want to pre-read: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1JOnrampCanvasDraft (seed), HubSpot:HS-53218

— Soojin

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Joint Onramp Canvas + starter template (draft)

Quick internal reply —

We can provision a temporary service account and short-lived API key same day. Ben will create the key and post it to the secure meeting note at kickoff.

On billing: Acme's 14-day PO window is reasonable. For pilots we typically offer a small trial credit (covers estimated token costs for the 30-day MAP). I can propose a $2k pilot credit in the approval packet; that usually removes friction for Procurement. If they need an invoice/PO path, we can accept PO and invoice net-30.

Ben — can you also prepare a short tech note (1-page) on the recommended test harness (how to run with sample prompts, how to capture latency p95/p50, and where to push logs)? I'll link it into the MAP slides.

Marissa Cole | Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
